meta.title: Independent MSP payment + CWF expectation ledger (Stage 2, written before any Python)
meta.derivation: Hand-derived from CMS Pub. 100-05 Ch. 5 §40.8-40.8.3 (PDF SHA-256 a2ea49af...f693, see docs/rules.md), Pub. 100-04 Ch. 27 §20, Pub. 100-05 Ch. 5 §10.1 and the README interface. No value was copied from COBOL output or fixtures/expected.json; CWF reference data is new and does not reuse fixtures/cwf.json.

categories.policy: expected value follows from a cited CMS rule (reason/CWF codes themselves are demo-defined)
categories.interface: expected value follows from the README/rules.md demo interface decisions, not CMS policy

meta.formula: payment = 0 if full=Y; else B = A if contract else C; cap = min(G, B); T = D + K; payment = max(0, cap - max(T, P)) == max(0, min(G-P, G-T, B-P, B-T))
meta.limits: Parity with COBOL on these cases is not proof of Medicare correctness.
